name: Kono mama da to Otouto ga Techno Break de Shinjau kara Kozukuri!
original_name: このままだと弟がテクノブレイクで死んじゃうから子作り！

My sisters who lived in America with mom after our parent's divorce suddenly came back!
Moreover, it's "masturbation prohibiton" for me due to examination, but who would ever thought that day would be its lifting. My plan is ruined.
And as for my anxiety of our reunion after about 10 years is.....
Not good! This is not good!! Only one sentence can describe their growth. (....too erotic.....)

And so I secretly confine myself to relieve myself but they overheard me.
"If it's like this, you're going to die from technobreak, what about impregnating us instead♪." 
What!! How has it come to this?!
Thus, the start of heart-pounding sex life a virgin with three hot nee-chan.
